main_text.head: III.
main_text.p: Optandi Adverbia, de re praeterita, II. Indicativum, aut Infinitivum; de praesenti aut futura, Optativum asscifcunt, ut:

p.i: αἲ δ' ὀφελως ἀγονός τ' ἐμεννα, ἀχαριστος τ'

main_text.head: IV.
main_text.p: Hortandi Adverbia, Imperativis & II. Subjunctivis junguntur, ut:

1. ἄγε φίλησόν με.
φέρε δή, ὡς ἂν θεὸς καὶ κεῖνο σκέψασθε.
main_text.head: DE SYNTAXI PRAEPOSITIONUM.
main_text.p: Praepositiones regunt post se casum, I. vel Genitivum, vel Dativum, vel Accusativum: & quidem vel unum tantum, vel duos, vel omnes tres.

page.notes: Greek text is partly faint; some Greek accents and letters are doubtful. The marginal "Q" and "1.Cum" at the foot may be a catchword or note; the marginal numbers are copied as they appear. Page is slightly stained.
